purpose: Qualify the specific alternative static sample and execute supported saved-model exact-line diagnostics; no reporting redesign or model tuning

snapshot.cutoff: Saved historical rows explicitly have as_of_UTC equal to scheduled kickoff, not the earlier closing quote clock. Reuse these unchanged kickoff-prefix reconstructions against the strictly earlier recorded closing threshold. Keep both clocks; no claim that these are earlier-quote-cutoff forecasts, original pregame issuance, or authenticated line freshness. decision_UTC is the original reconstruction cutoff, never backdated.
snapshot.dedup: One market per event/player/category/book/product/line-tier; reconcile paired O/U lines, do not count both sides as independent. Repeated source rows/native outcomes collapsed only on identical immutable values; conflicts held. Keep alternate/promotion/DFS/milestones separate.
snapshot.first_subset: All Pinnacle exact paired native-player O/U thresholds meeting independent event/contract/clock qualification. Hold ambiguous multiple thresholds per footballcase unless a separately registered source-only resolution qualifies; never choose based on outcomes.
snapshot.event_mapping: Exact home/away franchise allowlist plus NewYork calendar game date maps all32source events uniquely to the fixed107game schedule. Retain both kickoff clocks and deltas; source actual-ish commence differs by18-231seconds for16games. Snapshot must be strictly before BOTH source commence and original C scheduled kickoff; no silent event reset.
snapshot.line_tier: No explicit sportsbook main/alternate flag in sample. Report UNVERIFIED_MAIN_ALTERNATE and avoid main-line/difficulty superiority claims. Pinnacle strict O/U paired markets only initially; DFS/promotions/milestones are separate unsupported cells.

outcomes: Independent qualified NFL statistic/version/appearance checks; compare source actual_value and provider resolution separately. Provider grades are not venue settlement. No DNP-as-zero; preserve signed yards/zeroes/pushes/unknowns.

retention: C GitHub only for permitted licensed source snapshots/normalized evidence/aggregate results; temporary isolated local intake is not sole evidence. No migration/relabel of held ESPN/Sleeper inputs.
